query: I'm evaluating a 94‑year‑old woman. In female inpatients aged 89–99 with septic shock, within the first 48 hours what are the instability score Q1, median, Q3 and IQR? Also compare abnormal lab frequency to general inpatients and report cohort LOS and mortality.
final_sql: SELECT q1.q1, median.median, q3.q3, iqr.iqr, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM labevents WHERE subject_id IN (SELECT subject_id FROM patients WHERE gender = 'F' AND age BETWEEN 89 AND 99 AND shock = 'S') - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM labevents WHERE subject_id IN (SELECT subject_id FROM patients WHERE gender = 'F' AND age BETWEEN 89 AND 99 AND shock = 'S'))) AS abnormal_lab_count, (SELECT AVG(los) FROM icustays WHERE subject_id IN (SELECT subject_id FROM patients WHERE gender = 'F' AND age BETWEEN 89 AND 99 AND shock = 'S')) AS avg_los, (SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d_icd_diagnoses.icd_code = '30754' THEN d_icd_diagnoses.subject_id END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patients WHERE gender = 'F' AND age BETWEEN 89 AND 99 AND shock = 'S'), 0) AS mortality_rate FROM diagnoses_icd JOIN d_icd_diagnoses ON diagnoses_icd.subject_id = d_icd_diagnoses.subject_id WHERE d_icd_diagnoses.icd_code = '30754') AS mortality_rate FROM q1, median, q3, iqr;
